relations.subject: Shodo Harada
relations.evidence: After college he entered Shofukuji and began his training in 1962 under Rinzai Zen master and Japanese calligrapher Mumon Yamada, from whom he received Dharma transmission in 1982.

relations.subject: Shodo Harada
relations.evidence: Shodo Harada (原田 正道, Harada Shōdō; born 26 August 1940), or Harada Rōshi, is a Rinzai priest, author, calligrapher, and head abbot of Sōgen-ji — a three-hundred-year-old temple in Okayama, Japan.

relations.subject: Shodo Harada
relations.place: Whidbey Island in Island County, Washington
relations.evidence: in 1995 founded Tahoma Sogenji Zen Monastery on Whidbey Island in Island County, Washington
